model_allocation: One decoder layer at a time; selected input/output embedding rows only.

plan.runtime_estimate: Unmeasured: several minutes to roughly30minutes including CPU GEMMs, DeltaNet and19GB sequential tensor reads; guard deadline1800s. First-layer timing must precede approval of the full pass.
plan.numerical_scope: Exact decoded GGUF values in CPU f32; excludes native Metal fp16 activation/weight rounding.

independent_decoder.purpose: Use the original Q4_K NumPy decoder; only detach its inherited registration wrapper.

negative_a_adapter.reason: GGUF stores negative exp(A_log). Use those exact decoded values without a lossy log/exp round trip.

other_weights: Unchanged GGUF input/output embeddings, attention/DeltaNet projections, norms, convolution, and stored negative-A.
original_lexical_cross_swap: Diagnostic only; backbone run changes only the192 FFN matrices.
